scope.method: Direct comparison of every title/body/alt/limitation and all four panel directions against five cited retained original page images, current canonical Japanese lesson and linked knowledge IDs.

checks.gases: Photosynthesis: CO2 outside→leaf, O2 leaf→outside. Respiration: O2 outside→leaf, CO2 leaf→outside. All labels/formulas/directions match both source diagrams.
checks.transport: Soil water/mineral nutrients→roots→stem→leaves and leaf water vapor→outside correctly summarize absorption/transport/transpiration. Carbohydrates from photosynthesis leave leaves via stems for other parts/roots; origin differs from upward water.
checks.scope: Shared levels1/2 match both sources/current lesson. Four linked knowledge IDs exist in lesson paragraphs3–6. Companion concept comparison, not a full-plant diagram or recognition photograph.
checks.limits: Whole-plant organ-location recognition and independent recognition-image gaps remain partial/open. No claim of source-image reproduction, transfer speed/quantity or human/domain/native/device certification. No canonical lesson/hash mutation.
